newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade nonexistent - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade nonexistent - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate, with light demand. Asking prices $67.00 to mostly $68.00, bids $65.00, last sales of significant quantity on Tuesday, July 29 at $66.00.
Sales confirmed for the week to date including late Friday and the weekend on 7,800 cattle, all previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none last week - none last year - none
Wk to date - 7,800 last week - 7,000 last year - 3,700
